title: No readings in Xdrip from patched Librelink app
symptom: Using the LibreLink-xDrip patch on an AGM X3, the phone receives raw CGM values every minute (visible in logcat), but xDrip shows no readings. Logcat shows that readings are not delivered from com.freestylelibre.app.de to com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.
cause: The apps were restricted from associated autorun in the Autorun manager in Android System settings.
fix: The user solved the problem by removing the restriction on the apps in the Autorun manager in Android System settings.
evidence_quote: The problem was that the apps were restricted from accociated autorun  in the Autorun manager in Android System settings.
